description: Migrate a synchronous HTTP request-response pattern to an event-driven async pattern. Currently the order service calls the inventory and payment services synchronously, causing 2s latency. Must: introduce a Kafka queue, implement dual-path (sync + async) with a feature flag, shift traffic from sync to async (10% → 50% → 100%), verify event ordering and exactly-once delivery, and decommission the sync path. Risk factors: event ordering violations, duplicate events causing double-charging, consumers not ready for async, feature flag stale causing partial sync/async. Tools available: Kafka, feature-flags, kubectl, Helm, Prometheus.
